## MR methods

Analysis

-   Calculate area to be analysed
-   Should be 20% from trochanter major proximally and and 30% from the knee joint (leddflaten) distally
    -   Check Annlaug's master thesis for a formula for this

Layering order

1.  fat: 300-max, editable area: everywhere

-   Complete fat, check/edit every image -\> move to muscle

2.  muscle: 1-300, editable area: everywhere

-   Complete muscle, check/edit every image -\> move to bone

3.  bone: 0-750, editable area: everywhere

-   Complete bone, check/edit every image -\> move to intra muscle fat

4.  intra fat: 300-max, editable area: inside muscle/outside all segments

-   Complete intra fat, check/edit every image

check the end result

Quantification - Press "Quantification" -\> "Segment Statistics" -\> "apply" - Copy paste the data to an excel sheet - Win!
